NOTICE OF EXECUTIVE SESSIION - AREA PLAN COMMISION - OCT. 1ST
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Warrick County Animal Control Resumes Normal Business Hours
BOONVILLE, IN — Warrick County Animal Control is pleased to inform residents that full operations and standard business hours have resumed following a temporary closure.
Key Information for Residents:
Standard Hours: Office hours and public services have returned to standard operation (Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.).
Services Restored: In-person office visits, public intakes, and routine field services are fully active.
Contact Information:
Address:
599 Roth Road, Boonville, IN 47601
Phone:
(812) 897-6107
Email:
animalcontrol@warrickcounty.gov
We’re thrilled to announce the Warrick County Commissioners have just passed a Resolution 2026-12 to recognize September 25 (9/25) as “Give Like Dolly Day” in Warrick County. The resolution encourages Warrick Co citizens to support early literacy and Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library in Warrick Co in honor of Dolly Parton and all she has done to make a difference in this area. Stay tuned - we have lots of ideas to make this an amazing effort for our youngest citizens.

Warrick County Provides Update on Preliminary Data Center Inquiry
Button
Button
As you may be aware, the Evansville Metropolitan Planning Organization (EMPO), cooperatively with the City of Evansville, City of Henderson, Vanderburgh County, and Warrick County, has initiated, with the support of Michael Baker International (Consultant), the development of a Regional Transit Feasibility Study.
The study will explore opportunities to improve transit service and efficiencies across the Evansville Metropolitan Planning Area, including:
Metropolitan Evansville Transit System (METS)
Henderson Area Rapid Transit (HART)
Warrick Area Transit System (WATS)
We are excited to share that the survey for the Regional Transit Feasibility Study is live and will be available through August 31. We encourage you to complete the survey at this link:
https://engage-mbakerintl.com/empo-regional-transit/survey
Thank you for assisting us with gathering input for the Regional Transit Feasibility Study. Your support will enable us to better understand community needs and identify opportunities to improve transit service across Vanderburgh, Warrick, and Henderson counties.
